title: digitalis purpurea proles thapsi
intro: Digitalis purpurea proles thapsi, commonly known as Digitalis lanata or Woolly Foxglove, is a plant species that is a proles (or a subspecies) of Digitalis purpurea. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in the treatment of heart conditions such as atrial fibrillation and congestive heart failure. The health benefits of Digitalis lanata include improving heart function, reducing symptoms of heart failure, and lowering blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including glycosides like digoxin and digitoxin, which increase cardiac contractility and decrease heart rate, thereby exerting a positive inotropic and negative chronotropic effect.
